slides.title: Stop keeping your routine in your head. Your head is full.
Working memory is a tiny desk
slides.body: Holding 'did I run the dishwasher?' all day takes up space. Put it on paper and your brain gets that space back.

slides.title: Tape a list where the task happens
slides.body: Morning list on the bathroom mirror. Closing list on the kitchen cabinet. Laundry list on the machine.

slides.title: Use a weekly tracker, not a streak
slides.body: Streaks punish one missed day. A tracker shows 5 out of 7, which is a great week.

slides.title: Keep one master brain dump page
slides.body: Every 'I need to...' goes there. Pick 3 from it each morning. Nothing gets lost, nothing is urgent.

slides.title: Laminate or use a page protector
slides.body: Dry erase marker on a reusable list. Wipe it every night, and it's ready tomorrow.

slides.title: Paper remembers so my brain doesn't have to.
Get lists ready to tape up
slides.body: The Tidy Brain Printable Pack has mirror, kitchen and laundry lists plus weekly trackers. Link in bio.
